risks.description: Hydration timing: input typed or clicks made right after load are lost (2 runs, D 8)
risks.mitigation: Wait for a readiness signal (rows rendered, field keeps its value via toHaveValue) before interacting; web-first assertions, no fixed sleeps

risks.description: Native alert() for add, duplicate add and delete (D 8)
risks.mitigation: Register a dialog handler before the click, capture dialog.message(), accept it

risks.description: Third-party ads and trackers (Criteo, OpenX, DoubleClick, googlesyndication, etc.); an ad slot sits in the content area
risks.mitigation: Block the listed ad hosts with page.route; navigate with waitUntil 'domcontentloaded'. Do not block google.com/recaptcha on /register

risks.description: Shared public demo: the catalogue or site can change or be down; other people use the same site
risks.mitigation: Health-check base URL; assert by named books; record outages as environment failures

risks.description: Each browser has its own account (I2), but retries, parallel workers in the same browser project, or a concurrent run on the same account can collide; leftovers from failed runs pollute the collection
risks.mitigation: Tests that use the same browser's account run one at a time; each collection test uses its own book and removes only that book in setup and teardown (Q-NB4); never Delete All Books

risks.description: Unknown lockout threshold on the per-browser accounts (Q-NB1)
risks.mitigation: One wrong-password attempt per account per run (DQB-026, retries disabled); fake user names for other negatives; reuse storageState

risks.description: Registration / reCAPTCHA: the server accepts the request without a token; a valid password could create a real account
risks.mitigation: Only submit the weak value "abc"; never submit a pattern-valid value; never solve or bypass the captcha

risks.description: Duplicate element ids: #submit (Logout, Delete Account, Delete All Books), #addNewRecordButton (Back To Book Store, Add To Your Collection), #userName on login and register, menu item-N ids
risks.mitigation: Never locate by these ids; use role + exact name; Logout via /^Log ?out$/

risks.description: Labels not linked to inputs; search box and icon unnamed; delete icon is a span with title only
risks.mitigation: Use getByPlaceholder, getByTitle('Delete') scoped to the row, #delete-record-<ISBN> fallback

risks.description: Sort header accessible name changes after sorting
risks.mitigation: Regex header names /^Title/; assert via sorted-asc/sorted-desc labels and row order

risks.description: Responsive differences at 375px: menu collapsed, Publisher column hidden
risks.mitigation: Separate mobile scenarios; do not reuse desktop Publisher assertions at 375px

risks.description: Slow login redirect (3.9 to 5.1 s) vs default 5 s expect timeout
risks.mitigation: Longer timeout for the post-login URL assertion

risks.description: Fixed footer overlaps the lower left menu at 1280x900
risks.mitigation: Scroll into view; scope menu clicks to the Book Store Application group

risks.description: Expected console errors (400 on duplicate add and unknown ISBN; requestStorageAccess on /register)
risks.mitigation: Do not fail tests on console errors globally; allow-list these
